prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Kansas City?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” marketing agency in Kansas City — the right agency depends on your business, goals, budget, and the channels you need. That said, Kansas City is home to some highly regarded shops, including large, full‑service firms and smaller specialists. Two well‑known KC agencies are:

- VML (global digital and brand agency founded and headquartered in Kansas City) — strong on large brand work, digital experience and integrated campaigns.  
- Barkley (independent, full‑service creative agency based in KC) — known for creative brand and advertising work and large client partnerships.

How to pick the best agency for you
- Define your objective: brand awareness, lead generation, ecommerce growth, SEO, PR, etc.  
- Match specialty to need: choose a creative/full‑service shop for brand work; a performance/paid‑media shop for immediate growth; an SEO/content shop for organic traffic.  
- Budget and timeline: agencies range from boutique (lower retainer, more hands‑on) to global (higher fees, bigger teams).  
- Vetting criteria: relevant case studies, measurable results (KPIs), client references, team seniority, reporting cadence, and contract terms.  
- Test first: consider a small pilot project before committing long term.

Where to find and compare agencies
- Clutch.co, UpCity, Agency Spotter for ratings and reviews  
- Kansas City Business Journal and local industry awards for reputable shops  
- LinkedIn and Google reviews for client and employee perspectives

If you want, tell me:
- your industry and company size  
- main goals (brand, leads, ecommerce, SEO, PR, etc.)  
- monthly/annual budget  
I’ll shortlist 3–5 Kansas City agencies that fit your needs and explain why each is a good match.
